api-foundations.copy: Select composes field, trigger, searchable input, clear action, option surface, validation, loading, and events for one known option set. Searchable and clearable are explicit API capabilities that absorb the old Combobox/SelectCombo split instead of creating another source of truth.

props.name: label
props.notes: Visible label and accessible name source.

props.name: options
props.notes: Each option includes value, label, optional description, disabled reason, and metadata.

props.name: icon
props.notes: Optional leading Material Symbol for the selected domain, matching the reference dropdown treatment.

props.name: placeholder
props.notes: Must explain what kind of entity is expected.

props.name: searchable
props.notes: Turns the trigger into an editable combobox that filters by option label and metadata.

props.name: clearable
props.notes: Shows a trailing clear action when a value can be removed.

props.name: clearSelectionLabel
props.notes: Accessible label for the clear action.

props.name: emptyText
props.notes: Message for searchable mode when no option matches the query.

props.name: loadingText
props.notes: Status message for async searchable option lists.

props.name: loading
props.notes: Shows progress and blocks misleading stale options.

props.name: error
props.notes: Visible recovery copy; associate with field.

props.name: disabled
props.notes: Disabled states need explanation, especially permission-blocked.

props.name: density
props.notes: Maps the trigger and option rhythm to Design System Density.

props.name: state
props.notes: Documents visual and interaction state, including empty searchable results, without changing the option-set contract.

props.name: onChange
props.notes: Emits semantic value, selected option, source, and analytics metadata.
